comparator.name: Bachelor Geneeskunde
comparator.sourceNotes: Reconstructed from the official 2026-2027 OER and its appendices for the Erasmusarts 2030 curriculum. The programme has a total study load of 180 EC, distributed evenly across three bachelor years. The curriculum is integrated and programmatically assessed: the OER explicitly states that separate EC cannot be assigned to individual competencies or knowledge tests. Years 1 and 2 each comprise integrated case-based medical blocks, projects and longitudinal clinical, professional, societal, academic and technology lines. Year 3 contains a 30-EC minor, 29 EC of integrated medical study and one separately identified EC for longitudinal professionalism. The component model therefore preserves the official credit-bearing structure without inventing EC for individual clinical blocks.

components.name: Integrated medical curriculum — Bachelor year 1
components.note: Five case-based medical blocks, projects in medical science and sustainable public health, and longitudinal clinical-skills, professional-identity, societal, academic and technology education.

components.name: Integrated medical curriculum — Bachelor year 2
components.note: Five case-based medical blocks, projects in health technology and healthcare policy and management, and the longitudinal curriculum lines.

components.name: Minor
components.note: A coherent internal or external minor completed at the start of bachelor year 3.

components.name: Integrated medical curriculum — Bachelor year 3
components.note: Advanced integrated blocks in posture and movement, brain and senses, and ageing and the final phase of life, including end products embedded in the programme.

components.name: Longitudinal professionalism
components.note: The separately identified credit awarded for sufficient longitudinal professional conduct.

alternatives.distinctnessRationale: This route removes twelve specialist biomedical, laboratory, anatomy, infection, pharmacology and cognitive-neuroscience courses from the closest match. It adds economics, econometrics, sociology, organisational leadership, diversity management and policy communication. Fourteen of the 24 courses differ in each programme, and the organising choice shifts from individual biomedical mechanisms to population outcomes, prevention and healthcare institutions.

It differs from the public-health route by fifteen courses, replacing economics, sociology and organisational study with computational technology and biomedical applications.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest feasible UCR response covers biomedical science, body systems, disease mechanisms, health psychology, lifespan development, research, ethics and communication while preserving the absence of clinical medical training. Two further generator-backed directions remain. Population health, prevention and healthcare organisation support a policy-and-systems route; medical technology, evidence evaluation and innovation support a health-data-and-technology route. Each route is coherent, feasible and differs from every other route by at least twelve of 24 courses, so all three are included.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: The first integrated medical year combines biomedical knowledge, clinical skills, patient contact, projects and longitudinal professional formation. No single UCR course corresponds to that complete clinical component.

The second integrated medical year combines organ-system medicine, diagnosis and treatment, clinical skills and health projects. UCR has related academic courses but no sufficiently direct counterpart to the full clinical component.
The advanced integrated medical year combines later-life and organ-system medicine with clinical and professional integration. UCR does not offer an equivalent clinical component.
Both develop professional identity, conduct and reflection; the comparator embeds medical professionalism longitudinally, while UCR offers broader personal and professional development.

The comparator reserves a 30-EC coherent minor. UCR's complete programme is elective by design, so no single scheduled UCR course is a substantive counterpart to the comparator's separate minor component.
